question: 各区域销售额排名
sql:
SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: 区域销售额对 fact_sales.total_amount 求和；GROUP BY 后所有普通列用别名；ORDER BY 聚合别名降序即为排名。

question: 月度销售趋势
sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', d.full_date) AS 月份, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', d.full_date)
ORDER BY 月份
note: dim_date 没有 month 列，月度粒度用 date_trunc('month', full_date) 折算；季度可用 year + quarter_num，按日粒度用 full_date。

question: 品类销售占比
sql:
SELECT p.category AS 品类, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额,
       ROUND(SUM(f.total_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(f.total_amount)) OVER (), 0) * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: 占比 = 各品类 / 全部合计，用窗口函数 SUM() OVER () 取全量合计；NULLIF 防除零。

question: 客户等级贡献
sql:
SELECT c.customer_tier AS 客户等级, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_tier
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: fact_sales 通过 customer_id 关联 dim_customer；等级字段是 customer_tier。

question: 大客户 Top N
sql:
SELECT c.customer_name AS 客户, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
LIMIT 10
note: Top N 用 GROUP BY + ORDER BY 聚合后 LIMIT；明细类查询若不做聚合，建议 LIMIT 200。

question: 毛利率计算
sql:
SELECT p.category AS 品类,
       ROUND(SUM(f.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(f.total_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS 毛利率
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY 毛利率 DESC
note: 毛利率 = SUM(profit) / SUM(total_amount)；profit 是 fact_sales 的现成列，不要用 unit_price*quantity 自己算，会漏折扣。

question: 同比（年对年）
sql:
SELECT d.year AS 年份, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year IN (2023, 2024)
GROUP BY d.year
ORDER BY d.year
note: 同比要在同一 SQL 里取两年，用 dim_date.year 过滤；跨年增加幅如有需要再在外层聚合计算。

question: 各渠道销售额对比
sql:
SELECT f.channel AS 渠道, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额, SUM(f.quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_sales f
GROUP BY f.channel
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: channel 是 fact_sales 的直接列，无需 JOIN 维度表。

question: 各省份销售排名
sql:
SELECT r.province AS 省份, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.province
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: dim_region 有 province 字段（省），region_name 是大区（如华东）。分清两者，问「区域」用 region_name，问「省份」用 province。

question: 区域退货率
sql:
SELECT rc.region_name AS 区域,
       ROUND(SUM(rt.return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.total_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS 退货率
FROM fact_returns rt
JOIN fact_sales f ON rt.sale_id = f.sale_id
JOIN dim_region rc ON f.region_id = rc.region_id
GROUP BY rc.region_name
ORDER BY 退货率 DESC
note: 退货率 = 退货金额 SUM(return_amount) / 对应销售额；fact_returns 通过 sale_id 关联 fact_sales，再经 fact_sales 连 dim_region。

question: 退货原因分布
sql:
SELECT return_reason AS 退货原因, SUM(return_quantity) AS 退货量, SUM(return_amount) AS 退货金额
FROM fact_returns
GROUP BY return_reason
ORDER BY 退货金额 DESC
note: return_reason 是 fact_returns 的直接列；先按原因聚合，再可下钻到产品/区域。

question: 产品退货率 Top
sql:
SELECT p.product_name AS 产品,
       ROUND(SUM(rt.return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.total_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS 退货率
FROM fact_returns rt
JOIN fact_sales f ON rt.sale_id = f.sale_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY 退货率 DESC
LIMIT 10
note: 退货率分子在 fact_returns、分母在 fact_sales，必须经 sale_id 关联后再聚合。

question: 当前库存 / 可售量
sql:
SELECT p.product_name AS 产品, i.warehouse_id AS 仓库, i.quantity_available AS 可售量, i.quantity_reserved AS 预留量
FROM fact_inventory i
JOIN dim_product p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.date_id = (SELECT MAX(date_id) FROM fact_inventory)
ORDER BY i.quantity_available DESC
note: fact_inventory 按产品+仓库+日期记录快照；「当前」取最新日期 date_id = MAX(date_id)。可售量 = quantity_available。

question: 库存周转
sql:
SELECT p.product_name AS 产品,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(i.quantity_available), 0), 2) AS 库存周转
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN fact_inventory i ON f.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY 库存周转 DESC
note: 简化口径：库存周转 ≈ 销量 / 平均可售库存。若需精确业务口径，优先查 memory.semantic_entry 里的指标定义（Phase 2 Metric RAG 会承接）。

question: 出勤率
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 记录数,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = '正常')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS 出勤率
FROM fact_attendance a
note: 出勤率 = 正常状态记录数 / 总记录数；COUNT(*) FILTER 是 PostgreSQL 语法。status 字段值需先确认枚举（正常/请假/旷工等）。

question: 部门考勤对比
sql:
SELECT e.department AS 部门,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = '正常')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS 出勤率
FROM fact_attendance a
JOIN dim_employee e ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.department
note: fact_attendance 通过 employee_id 关联 dim_employee；department 在 dim_employee。

question: 节假日 vs 工作日销售
sql:
SELECT d.is_holiday AS 是否节假日, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY d.is_holiday
note: is_holiday 是 dim_date 的布尔字段，直接分组对比。

question: 时间过滤半开闭区间
sql:
SELECT d.year AS 年份, d.quarter_num AS 季度, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.full_date >= '2024-01-01' AND d.full_date < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter_num
ORDER BY d.quarter_num
note: 时间过滤用半开闭区间 [start, end)，含头不含尾，避免边界日期重复计入。相对时间（今年/上月/近 N 天）以当前日期为基准换算成 [start, end)。

question: 毛利率 Top 产品
sql:
SELECT p.product_name AS 产品, p.category AS 品类,
       ROUND(SUM(f.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(f.total_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS 毛利率
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name, p.category
ORDER BY 毛利率 DESC
LIMIT 10
note: 按产品+品类分组后再取毛利；GROUP BY 需包含所有非聚合列（product_name、category）。

question: 品牌销售对比
sql:
SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.total_amount) AS 销售额, SUM(f.quantity) AS 销量
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
note: brand 是 dim_product 的直接列；品牌粒度聚合无需下钻到产品名。
